mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gp_site_daily_stats (stat_date, pv, uv, new_views, new_likes, new_comments, new_articles, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{statDate}, #{pv}, #{uv}, #{newViews}, #{newLikes}, #{newComments}, #{newArticles}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE pv = VALUES(pv), uv = VALUES(uv), new_views = VALUES(new_views), new_likes = VALUES(new_likes), new_comments = VALUES(new_comments), new_articles = VALUES(new_articles), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(view_count), 0) AS totalViews, IFNULL(SUM(like_count), 0) AS totalLikes, COUNT(1) AS totalArticles FROM gp_articles
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM gp_user_comment) + (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM gp_article_comment)
